title: 莽山五指峰
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE beautiful vertical 4:5 collectible vintage watercolor travel poster in the style of the supplied China collage reference. Use the reference only for MEDIUM and TYPOGRAPHY, not its subject matter. Warm aged ivory paper with subtle fibers, extremely delicate realistic ink detail, translucent watercolor washes, soft edges dissolving into parchment, restrained mineral greens and blue-gray with warm ochre and small vermilion accents. Small Chinese brush heading at top, monumental but elegant antique-brown serif English title below, and small widely spaced location/subtitle. Fine understated corner ornaments. Keep title legible and the central artwork spacious. Depict one specified destination scene, richly composed with foreground, middle distance and atmospheric background; no boxed collage panels. Naturalistic proportions and identifiable characteristic landforms. No copied Great Wall, pagoda, panda, tea still life or other unrelated objects. No photography, no 3D miniature plinth, no engineering diagrams, no watermarks, no invented numeric tourism claims. No extra text except specified three heading lines. This is a coherent six-poster collection, with consistent paper color and typography.  SUBJECT: Depict Wuzhifeng in Mangshan, Yizhang, Chenzhou: monumental rugged granite peaks and sharply ridged rocky towers rising out of a deep sea of clouds, dense lush southern mountain forest wrapping the cliffs, wind-shaped pine trees growing from crevices. Show an elegant slender cliffside sightseeing walkway with visible protective railings following the rock face across the lower-middle part of the composition. Tiny walkers on the protected path emphasize scale; distant mountain peaks appear and vanish through flowing cloud layers. A dramatic but believable elevated three-quarter view, cool mineral-green forest, muted warm-gray granite, luminous ivory cloud sea, small peach sunrise. No climbers on unprotected ledges, no invented temples, no generic red sandstone hills. Keep the granite mountain and cloud sea dominant. Exact heading text: "莽山五指峰" / "MANGSHAN" / "CHENZHOU · HUNAN".
